english.title: Use vehicle on a road with a swivelling lamp / reflector
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[to which]_
(B)_[to the load of which]_
(C)_[to the equipment of which]_

was fitted a

(D)_[lamp]_
(E)_[reflector]_
(F)_[marking]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a vehicle
on a road
fitted with a lamp / reflector / marking

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
